Container.Name: brain-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP server exposing a markdown, PARA-structured Obsidian vault as read tools plus a single constrained write tool (capture, which only ever creates new notes in 00-inbox/). One container serves exactly one vault - for a second vault, add this template again with a different name/token/paths/port. Pulls the prebuilt image from GHCR, so there's nothing to clone or build first.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Host port to reach the server on. The container always listens on 3100 internally, so this is the only port value you need to change if running a second instance.

Config.Name: Vault (read-only)
Config.Description: Host path to the vault's root folder. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Inbox (read-write)
Config.Description: Host path to this SAME vault's 00-inbox folder - must be exactly the Vault path above plus /00-inbox. This is the only writable mount; it's what keeps capture() from being able to touch anything else in the vault even if the code had a bug.

Config.Name: Instance name
Config.Description: Identifies this vault in server logs and to MCP clients, e.g. personal or family.

Config.Name: Bearer token
Config.Description: Required on every MCP request from a client. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

Config.Name: BRAIN_ROOT
Config.Description: In-container vault path. Must match the Vault mount's container path above - leave as /vault.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: In-container listen port. Must match the MCP Port mapping's container-side value above - leave as 3100.
